name: Open Source Intelligence (OSINT)
description: OSINT is the foundation of every engagement. Before you ever step foot near a target, you should understand the organization's physical footprint, employee structure, security posture, and daily rhythms — all from publicly available sources. This includes social media, job postings (which reveal security vendors, access control systems, and software in use), satellite imagery, LinkedIn profiles, corporate websites, and leaked data. The goal is to build a target dossier that informs pretext selection, identifies key personnel to impersonate or social engineer, and reveals potential physical vulnerabilities before any risk is assumed.

blue.det: Unusual volume of employee LinkedIn lookups; Google Dorking patterns in web server logs; Shodan scans originating from non-customer IPs.
blue.cm: Limit public exposure of org charts; use LinkedIn privacy settings for sensitive roles; monitor for Google dork patterns targeting your domain; configure Shodan monitoring alerts.
